title: UI风格#103 - Brazilian Carnival (巴西狂欢节)
description: 创建第103种UI风格：巴西狂欢节风格 - 桑巴舞、彩色羽毛、街舞派对。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCY.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brazilian Carnival style When color palette Then features rainbow colors, neon yellow, hot pink, electric blue
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFD700 (金黄), #FF1493 (热粉), #00BFFF (电蓝), #FF6B6B (珊瑚红), #9ACD32 (青柠)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brazilian Carnival style When typography Then uses festive fonts: Bebas Neue, Montserrat, or Pacifico
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Bebas Neue (粗体), Montserrat (正文), Pacifico (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brazilian Carnival style When layout Then feathered banners, samba dancers, parade floats, confetti
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：羽毛横幅、桑巴舞者、花车巡游、彩屑飘落

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brazilian Carnival style When UI elements Then glitter effects, feather animations, drum beats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：闪光效果、羽毛动画、鼓点节奏、色彩爆炸

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brazilian Carnival UI When functional Then includes samba chat, dancer agents, parade stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：桑巴聊天、舞者代理、巡游统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brazilian Carnival UI When copy Then uses festive language: 'Samba', 'Fiesta', 'Rio', 'Festa'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SAMBA. FIESTA. RIO.'、按钮'SEND'→'DANCE'、'SUBMIT'→'CELEBRATE'
